# Who is the Greatest International Soccer Striker of All Time?

<p class="lead mb-4">This is the debate that never gets old: goals tell part of the story, but greatness is shaped by impact, consistency, and the moments that define a career.</p>

<p class="mb-4">In just 20–30 seconds, this project pitches a clear answer: by combining international scoring records with smarter performance measures, we turn a fan debate into a data-driven case for the true GOAT striker.</p>

<a href="analysis.qmd" class="btn btn-light btn-lg">Open the analysis</a>
:::

::: {.grid .g-4 .mt-3}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Why this question matters

- It brings together football history, statistics, and the meaning of greatness.
- A striker is judged not only by goals, but by influence on big matches and long-term consistency.
- The answer helps frame the sport’s greatest careers in a way that is clear and evidence-based.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### What the dataset reveals

- The project uses a cleaned international goalscorer dataset with player-level scoring information.
- Data science methods help compare players across totals, rate-based measures, and tournament relevance.
- The analysis turns raw numbers into a concise, presentation-ready conclusion.
:::
:::
